sourceEvidence.title: Quality Assurance Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
**Education And/Or Experience:** High School diploma; and at least five years’ supervisory/leadership experience in the quality field. .Documented training as AS9100 lead auditor.
**Required Skills/Abilities**
* In Depth knowledge of ISO 9001:2015, AS 9100D
* Knowledge in statistical process control concepts such as variation, stability, and process capability.
* Ability to program and operate CMM (Calypso) as well as various inspection equipment.
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and quality control process.
* Experience in the metal cutting and fabrication industry preferred.
* Certified Quality Manager (CQM) or similar certifications are a plus.
* Computer skills: Microsoft Office, Calypso, MeasurLink, ERP systems.
* Effective and professional communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Detail oriented and ability to multitask.
* Time management skills. Ability to prioritize and work under strict timelines.
* Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action implementation.
* Researching standards for quality provisions.
* PFMEA, PPAP, APQP, MSA, Control Plans etc. are preferred.
